_about: Short, realistic startup requests for testing the chatbot (tools/eval_scenarios.py --file). 'skills' = only the must-have skills (1-3), hand-labeled; obvious cases only.

scenarios.text: AI to answer customer support tickets for our SaaS app
summarize sales calls for our reps
we need a bot that writes Python code for our data team
detect angry customers in chat so we can escalate
forecast next month's demand from our order history
pull names, dates and amounts out of invoices
route incoming emails to the right department
plan delivery routes for our drivers with time windows
turn our product specs into marketing blog posts that are accurate
fintech app: explain fees and interest to users with correct math
read our dashboards and tell me what changed this week
HR startup: screen resumes without bias
moderate user comments on our social app
AI tutor that walks students through math problems step by step
break big engineering projects into tasks and a timeline
debug errors in our backend code
find the root cause when our server metrics spike
news app that summarizes articles without political slant
mental health journaling app that responds with empathy
legal tech: summarize contracts and flag risky clauses
travel startup: build itineraries that fit a budget and dates
health app answering medical questions, must not make things up
output product data as clean JSON for our API
predict which users will churn
analyze survey responses and find common themes
global e-commerce support that respects different cultures
negotiation assistant that figures out what the other side wants
fact-check claims in user posts
spot weird transactions that could be fraud
write SQL queries from plain English questions
